title: CF-AVSS: A Coarse-to-Fine Audio-Visual Speech Separation Framework with Target-Speaker Refinement and Post-Fusion for Real-World AVSE Challenge
abstract: arXiv:2610.21773v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Audio-visual speech enhancement (AVSE) leverages visual cues to recover target speech from mixtures corrupted by reverberation, noise, and overlapping speakers. We propose a coarse-to-fine two-stage AVSE framework. In the first stage, a progressive SPAV-TFGridNet is extended to two synchronized visual streams to produce visually ordered coarse estimates by progressively suppressing interfering speech while preserving target reverberation and shared background noise. In the second stage, a TFGridNet-based target speaker refinement network takes the original mixture and both coarse estimates as input to further recover target speech and improve signal quality. The coarse and refined estimates are finally combined using development-set-calibrated fusion. translated_title: CF-AVSS：一种面向真实世界AVSE挑战赛的、具有目标说话人细化与后融合的由粗到细视听语音分离框架
translated_abstract: 视听语音增强（AVSE）利用视觉线索从受混响、噪声和说话人重叠干扰的混合语音中恢复目标语音。我们提出了一种由粗到细的两阶段AVSE框架。在第一阶段，我们将渐进式SPAV-TFGridNet扩展为两个同步的视觉流，通过逐步抑制干扰语音、同时保留目标混响和共享背景噪声，生成视觉排序的粗略估计。在第二阶段，一个基于TFGridNet的目标说话人细化网络以原始混合信号和两个粗略估计作为输入，进一步恢复目标语音并提升信号质量。最后，通过在开发集上校准的融合策略将粗略估计与细化估计相结合。在ISCSLP 2026真实世界AVSE挑战赛上，我们的系统在赛道1的OVRL指标上并列第一，在赛道2上排名第二，同时在两条赛道上均取得了最低的字错误率（CER），分别为12.31%和（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了由粗到细的两阶段视听语音增强框架CF-AVSS，通过视觉引导的粗估计、目标说话人细化网络与校准后融合策略，在ISCSLP 2026真实世界AVSE挑战赛上取得赛道1并列第一、两条赛道CER最低的成绩。
en_tdlr: CF-AVSS, a coarse-to-fine two-stage audio-visual speech enhancement framework combining visually guided coarse separation, target-speaker refinement, and calibrated post-fusion, tied for first place on Track 1 and achieved the lowest CER on both tracks of the ISCSLP 2026 Real-World AVSE Challenge.
